title: Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large: Fine-Tuning a 560M Embedder for Tajik Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.00592v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Finding the passage that answers a question is the first step of most practical systems built on documents, and for Tajik we found no openly described model for it. We present Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large, a Tajik text embedder built from multilingual-e5-large-instruct (560M parameters). We asked our own Tajik language model to write questions for passages from Tajik laws, tax documents, Wikipedia and web text, and trained on 235,140 question and passage pairs for one epoch, with hard negatives chosen by another embedder and English and Russian pairs mixed in so the model would not forget those languages. On laws the model had never seen, the right passage is among the top ten results for 93.6% of questions, up from 80.2%; on tax documents, 94.5% against 82.6%. On Belebele, the one test we have that was written by people, the gain is smaller and not confirmed (92.2% to 95.2%, with touching intervals), and Russian and English do not change. On

translated_title: Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large：微调560M参数嵌入模型用于塔吉克语检索
translated_abstract: 找到能够回答问题的段落是基于文档构建的大多数实用系统的第一步，而对于塔吉克语，我们没有找到任何公开描述的相关模型。我们提出了Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large，一个基于multilingual-e5-large-instruct（5.6亿参数）构建的塔吉克语文本嵌入模型。我们让自己的塔吉克语语言模型为来自塔吉克斯坦法律、税务文件、维基百科和网络文本的段落编写问题，并在235,140个问题-段落对上训练了一个轮次，其中困难负例由另一个嵌入模型挑选，并混入英语和俄语的配对数据以防止模型遗忘这些语言。在模型从未见过的法律文本上，93.6%的问题能在前十名结果中找到正确段落，较之前的80.2%有所提升；在税务文件上，这一比例从82.6%提升至94.5%。在Belebele——我们唯一一个由人工编写的测试集上，提升较小且未能得到确证（从92.2%到95.2%，置信区间存在重叠），而俄语和英语的表现没有变化。
tldr: 提出了首个公开描述的塔吉克语文本检索嵌入模型Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large，通过自建语言模型合成23.5万余个问题-段落对微调5.6亿参数的多语言嵌入模型，在法律文本检索的前十命中率从80.2%提升至93.6%，同时保持英语和俄语能力不退化。
en_tdlr: We present Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large, the first openly described Tajik retrieval embedder, fine-tuned from a 560M multilingual model on 235K synthetic question-passage pairs, improving top-10 retrieval accuracy on unseen Tajik legal texts from 80.2% to 93.6% without degrading English and Russian performance.
